stories.title: China's economy grows 4.5% in the third quarter, beating forecasts as exports offset weak domestic demand
stories.reason: Retail sales grew at their fastest pace since March and industrial output also beat estimates, but a 20.6% drop in property investment remains a clear drag, and analysts say the stronger headline reduces pressure on Beijing for major new stimulus.

stories.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, striking an oil terminal in St. Petersburg
stories.reason: The attack also hit the Ruchi oil depot and a VK data center in direct retaliation for Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy grid, as Trump criticized Kyiv's refinery strikes and said he is holding off on new Russia sanctions while 'negotiating peace.'

stories.title: Egypt's top security body agrees to give Saudi Arabia 'all possible support' against Houthi attacks
stories.reason: President Sisi's National Defence Council move, which stopped short of joining the Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan mutual defense pact, came after Egypt's parliament authorized deploying troops abroad amid a conflict that has killed at least 19 people and disrupted thousands of flights.

stories.title: Zelensky says the US government is behind Ukraine's loss of Starshield satellite access; Trump and Rubio deny it
stories.reason: A Ukrainian defense official said the Pentagon-controlled SpaceX service's restrictions disrupted 'critical missions,' and a bipartisan group of senators is now asking the Defense Department's inspector general to investigate how the disruption happened.

stories.title: Trump's border czar says Rep. Ilhan Omar could be denaturalized and deported if immigration fraud is proven
stories.reason: Tom Homan's comments come after agents searched Omar's home and seized her phone, computers and passport in a probe critics call politically motivated weeks before the midterms, which Omar's attorneys say has 'no legitimate basis.'

stories.title: Schwab and JPMorgan block outside AI agents from logging into client accounts over security fears
stories.reason: Schwab's CEO said the firm blocks tens of unauthorized agent attempts weekly and will instead offer controlled MCP access for balance checks and research, while JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon said outside agents using customer credentials will be kept from moving money entirely.

stories.title: South Korea's Rebuilding Korea Party unveils an impeachment motion against Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae
stories.reason: The motion accuses Cho of breaching political neutrality in handling President Lee's election-law case, and while the Democratic Party holds enough seats to pass it alone, the opposition People Power Party calls the move a 'parliamentary coup.'

stories.title: Houthi negotiators say Oman proposed a five-day truce with Saudi Arabia to restart talks
stories.reason: A Houthi spokesman said the group would halt attacks if Riyadh meets unspecified 'humanitarian demands,' while Saudi Arabia disputes the account, saying it offered Oman-brokered talks back in July that the Houthis themselves refused to attend.
